correctness.rationale: For all r,h>0 and every projection normal, the exact planar support function is max(r times horizontal length, h times vertical coordinate). Cauchy integration gives an exhaustive two-branch elliptic formula. Derivative boundary terms cancel; the derivative sign is that of strictly increasing G_t on [1,sqrt(1+t^2)], whose sign at the upper endpoint is sqrt(1+t^2)-arsinh(1/t). Its derivative in t is positive, proving one critical ratio, all minimizers and uniqueness. The positive derivative at transition gives the square-root angle law; controlled asymptotics give the tall-cone limit. The included independent numerical checker reconstructs hulls and compares quadratures, as corroboration rather than a continuum certificate.
